key_insight: Exact certification reveals that some reported quantum error-correction distances are wrong, with discrepancies of at least eight in the audited literature.
engineering_relevance: Certified distances can guide circuit scheduling and defective-chip acceptance, improving error protection and estimated hardware usability.
method: Express code and circuit distances as tropical partition functions.
Evaluate them using rank-based dynamic programming and weight-bounded search.
Certify exact values by matching proved lower bounds with explicit logical errors.
evidence_signal: The method certified more instances than all other tested exact solvers combined on two benchmarks, scaling to 31,200-qubit codes and memory circuits with up to 800,000 fault mechanisms.
watch_item: Schedule improvements can add overhead: restoring IBM two-gross circuit distance from 16 to 18 at one noisy cycle required one extra timestep per cycle.
paper_title: Certifying quantum code and circuit distances at scale
